rulings.ruling: FAITHFUL — informative pairing intended by the source; no fallback.
rulings.reason: Round 3 changed the sources themselves so that ar/en now state the same pairing: «على طريقة العمارة المحلية … والشندل (خشبٌ كان يُجلب إلى الخليج)» / «in the local building tradition … chandal wood (timber once imported to the Gulf)». An en/ar reader meets exactly the same juxtaposition — a local way of building that relied on a timber brought into the Gulf — and that is the point the owner added (BRIEF round 3: readers asked whether chandal was local or imported; the answer is now explicit). The Chinese reader's pause is therefore the source's own information landing, not a defect introduced by translation. It is also not a logical contradiction in Chinese: 当地 modifies 营造传统 (a method), and the gloss itself states that Gulf traditional building commonly used this imported timber, which resolves the pause within the same sentence. Blind-reader remedy (b) 「当地传统上依靠进口」 adds a judgment (依靠) absent from the source; remedy (a) replaces source «local» with «Gulf» and reopens the locked lead-in — both rejected.
